segments.sn56.19:1.2: Tattha aparimāṇā vaṇṇā aparimāṇā byañjanā aparimāṇā saṅkāsanā –
segments.sn56.19:1.4: idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ … pe … idaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ … pe …‘idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccan’ti, bhikkhave, mayā paññattaṃ.
segments.sn56.19:1.7: Tattha aparimāṇā vaṇṇā aparimāṇā byañjanā aparimāṇā saṅkāsanā –
segments.sn56.19:2.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.

lines: Byañjanāti tesaṃyeva vevacanaṃ, vaṇṇānaṃ vā ekadesā yadidaṃ byañjanā nāma.
Ekamekasmiñhi sacce sabbākārena vitthāriyamāne vaṇṇādīnaṃ anto nāma natthi.
Yasmā pana akārādike sarasamaññā, kakārādike byañjanasamaññā, ubhayattha vaṇṇasamaññā, tasmā vuttaṃ “vaṇṇānaṃ vā ekadesā yadidaṃ byañjanā nāmā”ti.
Byañjanaggahaṇeneva cettha ākāraniruttiniddesā gahitā evāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Vibhattiyo hi atthavacaneneva vivaranti, tāhi kāraṇapaññattiyo vuttāyevāti, tāhipi atthapadāni gahitāneva honti.
Ayamettha saṅkhepo, vitthāro pana visuddhimaggavaṇṇanāyaṃ nettiaṭṭhakathāyañca vuttanayena veditabbo.
